landing.hero_sub: An AT Protocol question box for collecting anonymous messages
landing.hero_highlight_notify: Get Bluesky notices for new questions
landing.feature1_desc: Just sign in and MeyasuAt creates a message box with your own personal URL. Name it whatever you like — a question box, a marshmallow box, a feedback form. Receive anything on MeyasuAt.
landing.feature2_desc: Send messages anonymously, or sign in to leave your name on the message too.
landing.feature3_desc: MeyasuAt supports long, heartfelt messages. How long? Long enough to send the entire text of a famous short story like Hans Christian Andersen's "The Little Match Girl".
landing.feature4_desc: Attach images to your messages — picture letters, fan art, bug reports, anything goes. (For anonymous messages, images are kept for a limited time only.)
landing.feature5: Get notified on Bluesky when answers arrive
landing.feature5_desc: As soon as a message lands in your box, MeyasuAt's bot mentions you on Bluesky (setup required in advance). No more checking your box just to see if something new arrived.
landing.feature6_desc: When you're signed in, your questions and answers are stored in your own Bluesky PDS. The data belongs to you, and only you.
landing.how1_desc: Sign in with Bluesky to get your own message box URL.
landing.how2_desc: Add it to your profile or posts. Senders can write without signing in.
landing.how3_desc: Reply to long or image-backed messages and share them with rich OGP cards.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.article1_body: These Terms set out the conditions for using MeyasuAt (the "Service"). They apply to all users, including anonymous question submissions and named questions and answers using a Bluesky account (AT Protocol).
terms.article2_title: Article 2 (Service Content and Public Nature of Data)
terms.article2_body: The Service is a question box service integrated with Bluesky.
terms.article2_item1: Named questions submitted while signed in, and answers, are stored in the Service database and also in the sender's or answerer's own Bluesky PDS (personal data store). They are made broadly public through the AT Protocol network, including PDSs, Relays, and AppViews.
terms.article2_item2: Questions submitted anonymously are stored in the Service database and image storage, and are not published to the AT Protocol network. When the question box owner answers, the question text and attached images are saved as an answer record in the owner's own Bluesky PDS and become public through the AT Protocol network. If the owner hides the question instead, nothing is saved to the PDS — the question is simply deleted from the Service database.
terms.article2_item3: Question box owners may configure their own box to require named submissions. When this setting is enabled, anonymous questions cannot be submitted to that box.
terms.article3_body: Users must not engage in the following acts:
terms.article3_item1: Acts that violate laws, regulations, or public order and morals
terms.article3_item2: Posts that defame, slander, threaten, or invade the privacy of others
terms.article3_item3: Posts containing obscene or violent expressions
terms.article3_item4: Spam, or acts that place an excessive load on the Service's servers or network
terms.article4_item1: The operator may automatically filter submitted content (question text and attached images), whether anonymous or named, using systems such as moderation APIs provided by OpenAI, but does not guarantee that all inappropriate posts will be removed.
terms.article4_item2: The operator assumes no responsibility for disputes between users, data loss, the spread of data on the AT Protocol network, or other issues arising from use of the Service. This does not apply where the operator has acted intentionally or with gross negligence.
terms.article5_title: Article 5 (Changes to and Termination of the Service)
terms.article5_body: The operator may change the specifications of the Service or terminate provision of the Service without prior notice.
privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.section1_item_named: When using named features: Bluesky DID, handle, display name, avatar image, and other profile information. OAuth access tokens used for sign-in are kept only in your browser and are not stored on the operator's server.
privacy.section1_item_qa: When asking or answering: text data and attached images entered by users. For signed-in users, the bodies of named questions and answers are generally held in the sender's or answerer's own PDS. For anonymous questions, when the question box owner answers, the question text and attached images are saved to the owner's own PDS. If the owner hides the question instead, nothing is saved to the PDS — it is simply deleted from the Service database.
privacy.section1_item_app_db: Information kept in the app database: user settings information (planned as temporary until migration), session information, rate limit information, question read status, the body of unanswered anonymous questions, image keys for anonymous questions, and at-uris used to reference PDS records.
privacy.section1_item_cookie: Cookies: We use essential cookies to maintain login state and cookies to retain display language settings. We do not use third-party cookies for advertising or analytics.
privacy.section1_item_anonymous: Special note for anonymous use: For anonymously submitted messages, we do not collect or store access logs such as browser user agents. However, to prevent abuse and spam, we store the source IP address only after irreversibly hashing it in a form that cannot be matched with other information, and only for the purpose of limiting the number of submissions within a given period.
privacy.section2_item1: Providing and operating the Service, including displaying questions and answers
privacy.section2_item2: Preventing and responding to abuse, including text and image analysis by moderation APIs, rate limiting using hashed IP addresses, and bot detection using Cloudflare Turnstile
privacy.section2_item3: Maintaining login state and retaining display language settings
privacy.section3_title: 3. Third-Party Provision and External Transmission (Including Provision to Third Parties Outside Japan)
privacy.section3_atproto: AT Protocol network: Named questions submitted while signed in, and answers, are transmitted and published to decentralized networks such as Bluesky PDSs. When the question box owner answers an anonymous question, the question text and attached images are transmitted to and saved in the owner's own PDS. If the owner hides the question instead, nothing is transmitted to or saved in the PDS.
privacy.section3_moderation: Use of moderation APIs (OpenAI, United States): To automatically review the safety of submitted content, we send user-entered text data and attached images, whether anonymous or named, to APIs provided by OpenAI in the United States. The transmitted data is used only for review purposes and, under OpenAI's data usage terms, is not used to train OpenAI's AI models.
privacy.section3_turnstile: Use of bot detection service (Cloudflare): To prevent unauthorized access and spam submissions, the submission form uses Turnstile provided by Cloudflare. In connection with this use, information including the submitter's IP address is sent to Cloudflare in the United States.
privacy.section3_dm: Notifications (Bluesky DM): To notify question box owners about new messages, the official Bluesky bot account prepared by the operator sends notifications through Bluesky direct messages (DMs). Notifications do not include the question or answer body; they include only notification text and a link to the relevant page. These notifications are delivered only to owners who follow the bot account.
privacy.section3_config: Publication of question box settings: Settings such as the question box name, whether anonymous submissions are accepted, and whether notifications are enabled are stored as records in the owner's own Bluesky PDS and made public through the AT Protocol network.
privacy.section4_body: Images attached to anonymous questions that are saved in the Service's image storage are deleted 90 days after they are saved. Other data held in the app database is retained for as long as necessary to operate the Service unless deletion is requested, such as by account deletion. Data stored in PDSs is retained and deleted according to AT Protocol and the mechanisms of each PDS.
privacy.section5_body: The operator appropriately manages collected information and does not provide it to third parties without the individual's consent except as described in this Policy or where disclosure is required by law.
privacy.section6_body: For inquiries about this Policy, please contact the Bluesky account @suibari.com.
about.title: About MeyasuAt
about.lead: MeyasuAt is a free question box service that anyone with a Bluesky account can use.
about.feature1: Receive anonymous messages up to 10000 characters.
about.feature2: Senders can include images with their messages.
about.feature3: Signed-in senders can also include their Bluesky handle.
about.feature4: When you answer a message, you can share it clearly on Bluesky or X.
about.notice1_prefix: This app is developed and operated as a personal hobby project by
about.notice2: Because this is an individual project, support may be limited and the service may end without advance notice.
about.notice3: This app also stores question and answer data in its own database.
about.storage_anonymous_guest: Anonymous questions from users who are not signed in: stored in the app DB and image storage while unanswered. When answered, the text and images are saved to the box owner's PDS; when hidden, nothing is saved to the PDS and the question is deleted.
about.storage_anonymous_signed_in: Anonymous questions from signed-in users: stored in the app DB and image storage while unanswered. When answered, the text and images are saved to the box owner's PDS; when hidden, nothing is saved to the PDS and the question is deleted.
about.storage_named_signed_in: Named questions from signed-in users: stored in the app DB and PDS
about.storage_answer: Answers: stored in the app DB and PDS
about.notice_conduct: Please do not post messages or images that violate public order or standards of decency.
about.notice5: Attachments on anonymous questions that are saved in the Service's image storage are deleted 90 days after they are saved.
about.disclaimer: We assume no responsibility for damages arising from the use of this app, except where the operator has acted intentionally or with gross negligence.
about.notice4: The text on this page may change without advance notice.
